title: Towards Transparent and Knowledge-Distilled Deep Learning Networks for Protein Secondary Structure Detection from Cryo-EM Maps
content: Cryo-EM maps with medium resolution (5-10 Å) present significant challenges in accurate interpretation. Unlike high-resolution maps, amino acid side chains are indistinguishable, and the protein backbone is difficult to recognize. However, secondary structures such as α-helices and β-sheets can still be identified due to their distinct shapes. Since these secondary structures are fundamental building blocks of proteins, their relative positions in a 3D map provide important constraints for fitting atomic models.
